articles.title: Jury Says No to Elon Musk's Lawsuit Against OpenAI
articles.summary: A California jury quickly tossed out Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI. Musk said the company broke a promise to stay a charity, but the jury didn't agree. The trial lasted three weeks.

articles.title: Two Giant Power Companies Want to Join Forces
articles.summary: NextEra Energy wants to buy Dominion Energy for $67 billion. Together, they would serve 10 million homes in four states. The deal is driven by huge energy demand from AI data centers.

articles.title: A Giant Tortoise Took a Walk and a Whole Neighborhood Helped
articles.summary: A huge African tortoise named Rex escaped and strolled down a street in Scottsdale, Arizona. Neighbors jumped into action to find his owner. It shows how tough it is to care for these giant pets.
